name: export_minutes
title: Export minutes
description: Export one minutes version of a meeting through a registered exporter (call list_export_destinations for the destination names and their per-destination `options` schema). `minutes_version` defaults to the latest version. With run_async=false (default) the export runs synchronously and `result` is returned; with run_async=true an `export` job is enqueued and `job_id` is returned instead — poll get_job_status, whose `result` then has the same shape as `result` here. Exactly one of result / job_id is present. Every completed export is appended to manifest.exports (visible in get_meeting.exports). `options` is validated against the destination's options_schema before anything runs (e.g. {"output_path": "/abs/path/out.md"} for markdown / html; unknown keys are rejected). File exporters write only to an absolute `output_path` (default <NARUMI_HOME>/exports/<meeting_id>-v<n>.<ext>) and never overwrite an existing file or slides directory unless options.overwrite=true. Destinations that send data off this machine are subject to the meeting's external_send_policy. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result / job_id without exporting twice. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, minutes_version or destination), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), policy_violation (destination not allowed by external_send_policy), invalid_argument (options rejected by the destination's options_schema, a relative output_path, or an existing target without overwrite=true), busy (a job is queued / running for the meeting), internal.

destination.description: Exporter registry name from list_export_destinations (e.g. markdown, html).

options.description: Destination-specific options, validated against the exporter's options_schema (e.g. {"output_path": "/path/out.md"} for markdown).

minutes_version.description: Minutes version to export (see get_meeting.minutes_versions). Defaults to the latest.

run_async.description: Enqueue as an export job and return job_id instead of waiting (default false).

ref.description: Destination-specific reference to the exported document (file path, URL, page id).

job_id.description: Present for run_async=true: the enqueued export job.
